summary: Extract repeated workflow friction from conversation evidence and propose the smallest durable carrier without implementing it.

scenarios.title: Find repeated manual work
scenarios.prompt: Use the capture-repeatable-work skill on my five recent completed project tasks and find recurring manual verification steps.
scenarios.outcome: A small set of evidence-backed candidates routed to the narrowest useful instruction, script, skill, or automation.

scenarios.title: Assess one expensive workflow
scenarios.prompt: Use the capture-repeatable-work skill on this conversation and decide whether the workflow is stable enough to productize.
scenarios.outcome: A read-only candidate or a clear rejection when the evidence shows only an isolated lapse or transient incident.
